title: Unit 31 Consolidation: Memory Politics and Commemoration, 2010–2026
grammar: Review: order of events, attribution, participles, contrast and open questions
goal: I can summarise the main episodes of memory politics between 2010 and 2026, with years and sources.
I can put events in order, attribute judgements, set views against each other and state open questions.
I can give the result of the election of 12 April 2026 and the election of the prime minister on 9 May with dates.
